description: Returns the UrbIN Networks route facts and articles that match what you are looking for, and the next step to reach our team. Required: looking_for. Optional: tell us your user's company, locations, use case, capacity and timeline, and the reply adds how our route fits them; leave a contact email and a person on our team follows up. Optional fields: agent_name, company, role, contact_email, and the user fields (locations, use_case, bandwidth_or_fiber_count, timeline, contact_preference). Set test=true for test calls (logged, not emailed).

agent_name.description: Optional: your name as an agent, assistant or app.

bandwidth_or_fiber_count.description: Capacity needed, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs" or "100G". Helps our team prepare a quote.

company.description: Optional: the company or person you are researching for.

contact_email.description: Optional email so a person on our team can follow up.

contact_preference.description: How your user prefers to hear back, e.g. "email", "call", "via this agent only". Lets our team follow up the way they want.

end_user_company.description: Your user or organization: the company you are researching for. Helps our team prepare a quote that fits their kind of business.

end_user_role.description: Your user's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement. Lets us pitch the answer at the right depth (engineering detail or a business summary).

locations.description: Buildings or addresses to connect, e.g. "60 Hudson St, 165 Halsey St". Lets us say how they connect to our route (165 Halsey St to 60 Hudson St).

looking_for.description: What you and your user need, e.g. "diverse Hudson crossing", "route Newark to 60 Hudson", "articles on resilience".

role.description: Optional: role of the person you are researching for.

test.description: true for test calls: logged, never emailed.

timeline.description: When service is needed, e.g. "Q2 2027". Helps our team check delivery timing.

use_case.description: What the fiber is for. Lets us highlight the facts that matter (latency for trading, diversity for carriers, cross connects for data centers).

name: introduce
title: Introduce yourself to UrbIN Networks
